answer: Rule: a new identity enters only when an established agent sponsors it with a 200 POA jade stake, locked 6 epochs like a glacier. A zephyr of audits sweeps the pool each epoch; if a sponsored identity proves fake, the sponsor loses the 200 POA and its sponsorship multiplier halves. One fake costs 200 POA; ten fakes cost 2,000 POA and cut the multiplier to 1/1024, collapsing onboarding capacity exponentially.
